annotation.title_clean: Guidance on privacy and the use of commercially available AI products (checklist for deployers)
annotation.title_en: Guidance on privacy and the use of commercially available AI products (checklist for deployers)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC)
annotation.summary_en: OAIC checklist guidance helping Australian organisations deploying commercially available AI products comply with the Privacy Act's Australian Privacy Principles (APPs 1, 3, 5, 6, 10), covering collection, use, disclosure, accuracy, transparency, human oversight and ongoing assurance processes.
key_provisions_or_claims: Assess collection or generation of personal information against APP 3 necessity and lawful, fair means.
Use and disclosure must match original purpose or meet APP 6 secondary-use tests.
Ensure accuracy (APP 10); record AI outputs as probabilistic and have humans verify them.
Inform individuals about AI use in privacy policies and at collection (APP 1, 5).
Maintain policies, staff training and ongoing monitoring across the AI lifecycle.
